how_to_apply: The notice allows an offline application (by hand or by post) or an email application. The application must be submitted by 2 November 2026, 4.00 pm.
Write an application (ਬਿਨੈ ਪੱਤਰ) for the Guest Faculty (Punjabi) post.
Attach copies of all your academic documents to the application.
Scan the QR code printed on the notice and fill in your data in Annexure I(a) or Annexure I(b). The notice says this must be done when applying.
Deliver the application by hand or send it by post to the Department of Punjabi, Punjabi University, Patiala, or email it to the department's address, [email protected].
Make sure the application is submitted by 2 November 2026, 4.00 pm.

faq.question: Q1. How many Guest Faculty posts are in Punjabi University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Department of Punjabi, Punjabi University, Patiala needs 10 Guest Faculty (Punjabi) for graduate and postgraduate teaching. The department reserves the right to increase, decrease or cancel the number of posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Punjabi University Guest Faculty (Punjabi)?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted by 2 November 2026, 4.00 pm, either by hand or by post to the Department of Punjabi, or by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Punjabi University Guest Faculty (Punjabi)?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Punjabi Ph.D./UGC NET qualification. The guest faculty engagement is as per UGC guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of Punjabi University Guest Faculty (Punjabi)?
faq.answer: Remuneration will be paid as per University rules. The notice does not print an amount.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for Punjabi University Guest Faculty (Punjabi)?
faq.answer: Deliver the application by hand or send it by post to the Department of Punjabi, Punjabi University, Patiala, or email it to [email protected], with copies of all academic documents attached. You must also fill in Annexure I(a) or I(b) through the QR code on the notice.

faq.question: Q6. What are Annexure I(a) and I(b) in the Punjabi University guest faculty notice?
faq.answer: Annexure I(a) and Annexure I(b) are forms reached by scanning the QR code on the notice. Candidates must fill in their data in one of them when applying.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should be attached to the application?
faq.answer: Copies of all academic documents must be attached to the application for the Guest Faculty (Punjabi) post.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Punjabi University Guest Faculty (Punjabi) job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the appointment will be purely temporary.
